obligations.expected_behavior: Preserve the membership, paths, and byte contents of all frozen historical records unchanged when repair or runtime evidence is handled.
forbidden_result: Any addition, removal, relocation, renaming, or byte modification of frozen historical records.
obligations.observable_result: A comparison before and after the operation shows identical frozen historical membership, paths, and bytes.
obligations.state_after: Frozen historical membership, paths, and bytes remain identical.
obligations.state_before: Frozen historical records exist with established membership, paths, and byte contents.
obligations.subject: Frozen historical records
obligations.trigger: When repair or runtime evidence is produced or updated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Append repair and runtime evidence only within their declared boundaries.
forbidden_result: Writing repair or runtime evidence outside the declared boundaries.
obligations.observable_result: New repair and runtime evidence is present as appended content under the declared boundaries, with prior evidence retained.
obligations.state_after: Repair and runtime evidence has been appended within the declared boundaries.
obligations.state_before: Declared boundaries exist for repair and runtime evidence, with any prior evidence retained.
obligations.subject: Repair and runtime evidence
obligations.trigger: When repair or runtime evidence is recorded.
